description: Dated SCHEDULED economic events from OFFICIAL publishers only (central banks, BLS, ONS). Scheduled times only: no actual/forecast/previous values are stored, so nothing here can leak a realised figure into a backtest. All event_time values are UTC; local_date/local_time/local_tz record the publisher's own clock so every conversion can be re-derived.
licence_note: Dates are facts published by public bodies (Federal Reserve, ECB, Bank of England, Bank of Japan, US BLS, UK ONS under the Open Government Licence). No commercial aggregator (ForexFactory, Investing.com, Trading Economics, etc.) was used.

coverage.rule: declared_start: every source was enumerated from 2024-01-01, so the absence of an event after that instant is a fact. declared_end: the EARLIEST last-published event across sources, so a span is only reported as covered where every source is complete.
coverage.not_covered: Anything before 2024-01-01; any currency other than USD/EUR/GBP/JPY (AUD, CAD, CHF, NZD have no events); euro-area data releases (HICP flash, GDP); US data other than NFP and CPI; FOMC minutes and press conferences as separate events.

taxonomy_extensions.uk_gdp_monthly: UK monthly GDP estimate (ONS). Not in recurring_economic_events.json; declared here.

impact_note: Every event is stored as impact=high, as specified for this fixture. The recurring taxonomy rates uk_employment as medium; blackout queries at min_impact=high therefore include the UK labour and monthly GDP releases.

fed_fomc.authority: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
fed_fomc.time_rule: 14:00 America/New_York on the final day of each scheduled meeting (statement time; the page lists dates only, the 14:00 ET statement time is the Fed's standing practice)
fed_fomc.method: HTML fetched and parsed (fomc-meeting__month / fomc-meeting__date cells); cross-checked with WebFetch
fed_fomc.exclusions: 2025-08-22 notation vote on the longer-run strategy statement excluded (not a scheduled rate decision). The Fed states every date is tentative until confirmed at the preceding meeting; 2027 events carry status 'tentative'.

ecb_governing_council.method: Past: 'Monetary policy decisions' press releases (ecb.mpYYMMDD) from the decisions index; future: Day-2 'monetary policy meeting ... followed by press conference' rows of the meeting calendar
ecb_governing_council.exclusions: Non-monetary policy meetings and General Council meetings excluded.

boe_mpc.method: 2026-2027 from the 'confirmed dates' lists; 2024-2025 from the 'Published on' date of each Monetary Policy Summary and minutes page (months without an MPC redirect and were skipped)

boj_mpm.series: Monetary Policy Meeting decisions (final day of each MPM)
boj_mpm.time_rule: NO FIXED TIME. time_known=false; event_time = 09:00 Asia/Tokyo (00:00Z) and window_end = 14:00 Asia/Tokyo (05:00Z), a deliberately conservative window: announcements usually land late morning JST but have run past noon
boj_mpm.method: HTML tables parsed; for held meetings the decision date was cross-checked against the statement PDF name (kYYMMDDa.pdf)

bls_empsit.method: bls.gov refuses scripted HTTP (403), so dates were read with WebFetch: archive release links (empsit_MMDDYYYY.htm, dates encoded in the URL) and the published schedule table (which states 08:30 AM)
bls_empsit.exclusions: October 2025 Employment Situation was not published (2025 lapse in appropriations); September 2025 data released 2025-11-20. BLS has not published a 2027 schedule (bls.gov/schedule/2027/home.htm returned 404).

bls_cpi.method: As bls_empsit (cpi_MMDDYYYY.htm archive links plus the schedule table)
bls_cpi.exclusions: October 2025 CPI was not published (2025 lapse in appropriations); September 2025 CPI released 2025-10-24. No 2027 schedule published.

urls: https://api.beta.ons.gov.uk/v1/search/releases (the ONS release calendar's own API; Open Government Licence)
ons_cpi.time_rule: 07:00 Europe/London (the API returns UTC; every value was asserted to be 07:00 UK time)
ons_cpi.method: Published and CONFIRMED releases titled 'Consumer price inflation, UK: <Month YYYY>'; 'time series' companion releases and cancelled entries dropped
ons_cpi.exclusions: 11 PROVISIONAL dates (2027-02 onwards) dropped: provisional ONS dates can move.

ons_labour_market.method: As ons_cpi; titles vary ('UK labour market: <M>', 'UK Labour Market <M>'); every date cross-checked against the same-day 'Labour market in the regions of the UK' release

sources_skipped.bls_2027: BLS has not published a 2027 release schedule (404).
sources_skipped.ons_provisional: ONS provisional dates dropped (11 UK CPI dates in 2027).
sources_skipped.aggregators: ForexFactory / Investing.com / similar deliberately not used (terms forbid automated extraction).
